description: The iterator used as a value is an object holding its key and value
notes: The examples use the iterator's key and value with attribute access, which makes the iterator an object with those attributes (see native/dynamic-blocks/iterator-index-by-name), but the README doesn't say what the key is (see native/dynamic-blocks/key-tuple-index). hashicorp/hcl gives the element's index, and builds the object in iteration.Object in ext/dynblock/iteration.go.
